description: This file contains classes and functions for managing and executing build, test, and filtering processes within the Zephyr project testing framework, including handling CMake builds, test case detection, and reporting.

classes.name: ExecutionCounter
classes.description: Class for tracking and reporting test execution statistics, including counts of passed, failed, skipped, and errored test cases and suites.

classes.name: CMake
classes.description: Class for configuring, building, and parsing CMake projects within the Zephyr testing framework.

classes.name: FilterBuilder
classes.description: Subclass of CMake for handling filtering stages in the build process, including parsing generated configuration data.

classes.name: ProjectBuilder
classes.description: Class for managing the full build, test, and reporting pipeline for a test instance, including handling logs, artifacts, and test case detection.

classes.name: TwisterRunner
classes.description: Main class orchestrating the execution of multiple test instances and suites, managing task queues, parallel execution, retries, and reporting.

methods.name: parse_generated
methods.description: Parses generated CMake or configuration files to extract build and filter information.

methods.name: run_build
methods.description: Executes the build process using CMake or other build tools, capturing output and handling errors.

methods.name: run_cmake
methods.description: Runs CMake configuration with specified arguments and parses the output.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Performs the build step, optionally invoking a harness for additional build procedures.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the test instance, configuring handlers, and managing test execution flow.

methods.name: gather_metrics
methods.description: Collects size and footprint metrics from the built binary.

methods.name: calc_size
methods.description: Calculates size metrics for a test instance based on build logs or other data.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main processing loop for handling different pipeline operations such as filtering, building, running, and reporting.

methods.name: determine_testcases
methods.description: Analyzes ELF files to detect test case symbols and updates the test instance accordingly.

methods.name: cleanup_artifacts
methods.description: Removes unnecessary build artifacts, preserving only essential files.

methods.name: cleanup_device_testing_artifacts
methods.description: Removes artifacts specific to device testing, keeping binaries and configuration files.

methods.name: _get_artifact_allow_list_for_domain
methods.description: Returns list of files needed for testing a specific domain.

methods.name: _get_binaries
methods.description: Retrieves list of binary files for the test instance based on platform info and runners.yaml.

methods.name: _get_binaries_from_runners
methods.description: Extracts binary paths from runners.yaml for a given domain.

methods.name: report_out
methods.description: Outputs test results, updates statistics, and logs status for each test instance.

methods.name: cmake_assemble_args
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for CMake based on extra configs, overlays, and handler options.

methods.name: cmake
methods.description: Runs CMake configuration with assembled arguments.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Performs the build step, invoking the build system.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the test instance, configuring handlers and executing tests.

methods.name: gather_metrics
methods.description: Collects size and footprint metrics for the test instance.

methods.name: calc_size
methods.description: Calculates size metrics from build logs or other sources.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute the test process, including configuration, build, and execution.

methods.name: update_counting_before_pipeline
methods.description: Prepares statistics before starting the test pipeline, accounting for static filters.

methods.name: show_brief
methods.description: Displays a summary of the current test run statistics.

methods.name: add_tasks_to_queue
methods.description: Adds test instances to the processing queue based on their current status and options.

methods.name: pipeline_mgr
methods.description: Manages execution of tasks in the pipeline, supporting Linux and non-Linux platforms.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Starts worker processes to process queued tasks.

methods.name: get_cmake_filter_stages
methods.description: Analyzes filter expressions to determine required filtering stages.
